add.title: Transgender legal history in the United States (Wikipedia)
add.summary: Wikipedia's survey of US transgender legal history documents the shifting federal framework for housing trans prisoners: a January 2015 ICE memo directed housing transgender immigration detainees according to gender identity, and in 2016 the US Department of Justice released guidelines forbidding corrections agencies from assigning trans inmates to men's or women's units solely on birth anatomy. In 2018 the Federal Bureau of Prisons revised its Transgender Offender Manual the other direction - deleting the sentence that the Transgender Executive Council 'will recommend housing by gender identity when appropriate' and instead making placement 'a case-by-case basis' in which 'biological sex' is 'the initial determination', with gender identity used only 'in rare cases'. No Delaware- or Maryland-specific placement policy is covered. Article last revised 2026-06-12; accessed 2026-10-04.
